item.title: Guest Commentary | Meals and Wheels: The beauty of a community showing up for its seniors
item.description: "If we are serious about honoring the generation that built Santa Cruz County, we must remain equally serious about protecting and strengthening the systems that support them," writes Dana Wagner in a Guest Commentary.

item.title: Photo | Waves roll in to Manresa State Beach
item.description: Waves roll in to Manresa State Beach on a recent afternoon. Manresa is a state-protected beach on Monterey Bay near La Selva Beach that has two state-owned and operated facilities associated with it: Manresa Main State Beach, and Manresa Uplands State Beach and Campground.

item.title: Photo | Yard signs to be sold at fundraiser in Santa Cruz
item.description: Messages of love, support and dissent fill the Live Oak studio of artist Myra Eastman this week as Eastman organizes yard signs after they were waterproofed with a poly sealer. The signs, created by members of AART (Artists Respond and Resist Together), bear messages of support for the residents of Minnesota will be sold on Saturday at an event at m.k. contemporary art gallery in downtown Santa Cruz.

item.title: Slow start costs Cal women in ACC Tournament loss to Syracuse
item.description: After trailing 37-16 at halftime, Cal staged a big comeback in their eventual 70-59 second-round loss, closing within four points midway through the fourth quarter.
